chunks: There is no reason preventing his appearance except his fear for his own life from being killed, because if it were otherwise, concealment would not have been permissible for him, and he would have borne hardships and annoyance; for the ranks of the Imams and likewise the Prophets, peace be upon them, are only exalted because of their bearing the great hardships for the sake of Allah, the Exalted.
ai.seo_question: Why is the delay in the reappearance of the Imam of the Age attributed to fear of death?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi argues that the Imam's concealment (istitar) is a strategic necessity driven by the fear of assassination, as enduring hardship alone would not justify hiding if safety were not at stake. This passage underscores the theological principle that the spiritual station of the Imams and Prophets is elevated precisely through their endurance of significant trials (shada'id) for the sake of God, linking their personal sacrifice to the broader divine plan.
